item.title: It takes more than just engineers to build the future of AI — it also takes people who can turn complexity into a clear strategy. Tara, Executive Bus...
item.description:
It takes more than just engineers to build the future of AI — it also takes people who can turn complexity into a clear strategy. Tara, Executive Business Partner in the Cloud Applied AI team, is that reliable anchor. While her team builds the future of Google Cloud, Tara ensures leadership stays focused on technical breakthroughs. “AAI (Applied AI) is very fast-moving with shifting priorities,” she explains. “As the ‘right-hand’ to the VP of Eng, my job is to ensure that she can focus on technical breakthroughs while I manage the ‘business of the business’.”
Beyond her core work, Tara’s involvement with GAIN (Google Aboriginal and Indigenous Network) helps bridge the gap between innovation and local culture — like naming meeting rooms using Indigenous languages and concepts. “GAIN Canada coordinates with local Elders and language speakers to ensure that the chosen names are appropriate, respectful and used with permission,” she explains.
If you’re ready to bring your own strategy to the world of AI, explore our open roles → https://goo.gle/48mIFui

item.title: "With AI the art of the possible has really changed. That means we can drive innovation in ways that we previously couldn't." — Ruth Porat Debbie W. ...
item.description:
"With AI the art of the possible has really changed. That means we can drive innovation in ways that we previously couldn't." — Ruth Porat
Debbie W. and Ruth Porat discuss with our partners at Imperial College London, Discovery Group and OTTO how leaders should be thinking about AI.
Hear how organizations around the world are using AI to create real-world impact, including: -Breast cancer research improvements with Imperial College London, resulting in detecting cancer earlier with fewer false positives and false negatives  -Using AI tools to scale making millions of people healthier at the Discovery Group -Surfacing deep insights in real time across thousands of business subcategories at retailer OTTO by leveraging AI
Thanks to Prof. Hugh Brady, Adrian Gore, Dr. Boris Ewenstein or the conversation!

item.title: Water is a critical component of data center development and operations, which not only power Google tools like Search and Maps, but also things like ...
item.description:
Water is a critical component of data center development and operations, which not only power Google tools like Search and Maps, but also things like healthcare, online banking and 911 systems.
The aggregate water consumption of U.S. data centers is small — they use less than 1% of the water that Americans use on their lawns annually. Nevertheless, we are focused on protecting local water resources in all aspects of our data center operations.
That’s why we’re announcing several water stewardship commitments to be responsible and transparent in our water use.
Learn more: https://goo.gle/4uJTPlL

item.title: “If you want a career where you can still be a builder, but your 'builds' directly shape the future of AI, the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) team i...
item.description:
“If you want a career where you can still be a builder, but your 'builds' directly shape the future of AI, the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) team is exactly where you belong,” says Flávio Franco, Managing Director AI Tech Lead for Google Cloud. “Because you are building with our newest AI models in the wild before anyone else, you serve as Google's 'ground truth.’ The friction you overcome and the novel solutions you code directly feed back into our engineering teams.”
Flávio describes the day-to-day as a hybrid of strategic consulting, hands-on building and product development: 💡 Sitting down with customer executives to understand a business bottleneck — like how to completely reimagine their customer service using AI. 💻 Partnering with the customer's developers. The FDE is writing code, unblocking technical hurdles, and proving that our most advanced AI models can integrate with the customer's specific data securely.
If you enjoy balancing technical coding with business transformation, check out our open Forward Deployed Engineer roles → https://goo.gle/3PUwMWc
